targets.title: A polymorphism in CALHM1 influences Ca2+ homeostasis, Abeta levels, and Alzheimer’s disease risk.
targets.evidence_quote:
Several independent research groups have observed
that P86L and other CALMH1 markers modulate the

AAO only under a recessive model [1,2,4,11]. These

observations reinforce a hypothetical recessive model

for the P86L variant in AD. So, we decided to evalu-

ate this model in AAO in Spanish AD patients.
targets.outcome_quote:
Both results

are compatible with the original ﬁndings [1], although
the observed genetic model for the P86L mutation in

Spanish series seems different. In fact, we observed a

recessive instead a dominant model as originally pro-

posed.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Outcome follows the explicit comparisons; the disease-risk nulls of prior replication papers are not themselves the age-at-onset claims re-tested here.
